description: This file implements the HttpRequest class, which handles HTTP request parsing and response in the rialto::servermanager namespace. It includes methods for extracting HTTP method, command, parameters, and post data, as well as replying to requests.

classes.name: HttpRequest
classes.description: A class representing an HTTP request, capable of parsing request details and sending responses.

methods.name: HttpRequest::HttpRequest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HttpRequest object by parsing the connection and request info, extracting method, command, parameters, and post data.

methods.name: HttpRequest::getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method of the request.

methods.name: HttpRequest::getCommand
methods.description: Returns the command part of the URI.

methods.name: HttpRequest::getParams
methods.description: Returns the URI parameters as a vector of strings.

methods.name: HttpRequest::reply
methods.description: Sends a reply message over the connection.
